description: Update fields on an existing catalog brand by id: name, slug, description, website and description translations. Provide a patch with at least one field; use list_brands first to find the id and current values. Renaming a brand changes the vendor name sent to marketplaces, so rename only on the user's explicit request; the name is never translated. Translations REPLACE the whole set when sent (an empty array removes them all) and are left untouched when omitted — translate only the brand's own description, add no facts. The result is the updated brand and echoes the operating workspace.

id.description: The brand id returned by list_brands.

patch.description: The brand fields to update; include at least one changed field.

description.description: Brand description in the workspace's base language (up to 4000 characters). Send null to clear it.

name.description: The brand name exactly as marketplaces know the vendor, up to 120 characters; unique in the workspace. Never translated.

slug.description: URL segment for the brand. Normalized to lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens whatever is sent; derived from the name when omitted.

translations.description: Brand description per locale (the brand NAME is never translated). Omit to leave existing translations untouched; when sent it REPLACES the whole set, so an empty array removes them all.

locale.description: Content locale, one of the workspace's supported languages.

website.description: The brand's website as a full https:// URL. Send null to clear it.

name: update_brand
title: Update brand
